evidence.reason: At the pinned adapter code, `stop_and_drain()` performs the durable mask/stop/drain and then unconditionally calls `_read_completions()` at line 933. `_read_completions()` refuses on an unreadable or oversized completion log (lines 969 and 971). That makes completion-log validity a prerequisite for the fence method returning, so the rollback path cannot reach `restore()` when the log is malformed and the service stays masked. The completion baseline is needed to block installation on the forward switch path, not to establish the rollback fence; putting it on the forward path (while retaining ownership/liveness checks for restore) is the smallest compatible correctness fix.
